topic: Buggy as the Cross Guild figurehead: Mihawk and Crocodile put him out front, and the Yonko title came from a misunderstanding
title: Buggy Is the Cross Guild's Figurehead, Not Its Brain
description: Buggy is the Cross Guild's public face, and Mihawk and Crocodile are the reason. Fan summaries of chapter 1082 say his Yonko status grew out of a misunderstanding, and this Short walks through how that happened. Is he the boss, or the face the real founders hide behind?
comment: Is Buggy a joke who got a title by accident, or the front man chosen on purpose?

lines.text: Buggy is the Cross Guild's figurehead, and that was Mihawk's plan.

shot.fallback: anime style, a clown-like pirate posed as a figurehead on a ship

lines.text: Mihawk didn't want to become a Yonko, or the attention that comes with it.

shot.fallback: anime style, a swordsman in a dark coat standing in shadow

lines.text: So he put Buggy in front to pull the spotlight away from himself.

shot.fallback: anime style, a clown-like pirate in a spotlight with a swordsman in shadow

lines.text: Crocodile agreed, because they could eliminate Buggy at any time.

shot.fallback: anime style, a dark-suited pirate and a swordsman in a dim hall

lines.text: Then Buggy's crew printed flyers with his face in the center.

shot.fallback: anime style, a stack of flyers with a clown-like pirate in the center

lines.text: The World Government read that as a leadership claim, and Buggy got the Yonko title.

shot.fallback: anime style, an official-looking notice with a clown-like pirate on it

lines.text: Chapter 1082 summaries say Mihawk and Crocodile don't see him as the same caliber.

shot.fallback: anime style, three powerful captains standing apart from a clown-like pirate

lines.text: Here's my read: the title rests on a misunderstanding, not on strength.

shot.fallback: anime style, a confused clown-like pirate looking at a title

lines.text: But that's exactly the point, because a figurehead takes the first hit.

shot.fallback: anime style, a figurehead pirate facing a crowd

lines.text: So the Cross Guild has a face everyone watches, and two strong founders behind it.

shot.fallback: anime style, a clown-like face in front of two dark silhouettes

lines.text: Ask who really runs the guild, because the front man was picked by someone else.

shot.fallback: anime style, a clown-like pirate standing before two shadowy figures

self_check.loop: Last line says someone else picked the front man, which leads into line 1 about the figurehead plan.
